description.value: Red Wasabi is a quick-service sushi spot on Davie Street in Vancouver, specializing in 100% gluten-free inari, fresh rolls, and rice bowls prepared daily from locally sourced ingredients. The restaurant emphasizes plant-based options and sustainable sourcing, making it a health-conscious stop for cyclists. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available, and online ordering for pickup and delivery is offered.
